$comment: Source and licence record for every external asset shipped in public/assets. tests/manifest.test.ts fails if a shipped file is missing here.

characters/footballer.glb.description: Game footballer: one skinned body, 8 swappable heads, 38 retargeted animation clips. Built by the project's pipeline from the sources listed.
characters/footballer.glb.rig: Rocketbox/3ds Max Biped-style, 80 joints (pelvis, spine_01-03, thigh/calf/foot/ball, clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand, fingers, facial)
characters/footballer.glb.modifications: Textures resized and the kit areas of the body texture desaturated so the shader can recolour them; a per-vertex kit-region id stored in COLOR_0.r; heads from other Rocketbox avatars rebound to this skeleton by joint name; animations retargeted to the Rocketbox rig, made in-place and trimmed.

rocketbox-sports-male-03.name: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library: Sports_Male_03
rocketbox-sports-male-03.author: Microsoft Corporation (Rocketbox Studios)
rocketbox-sports-male-03.attribution: MIT notice must be kept with copies (see docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

rocketbox-heads.name: Microsoft Rocketbox heads: Male_Adult_04, Male_Adult_12, Construction_Male_03, Construction_Male_08, Fire_Male_06, Military_Male_04, Business_Male_05
rocketbox-heads.author: Microsoft Corporation (Rocketbox Studios)
rocketbox-heads.note: Generic stock avatars. They are NOT Nigerian-specific likenesses and carry no custom facial features.

mixamo-user-clips.name: Mixamo animations downloaded by the project owner: Soccer dribble, pass, strike, kick, header (x2), throw-in, jog (8 directions), goalkeeper side-step / diving save / body block / scoop / pass / placing ball, soccer trip, soccer tackle (x2)
mixamo-user-clips.author: Adobe
mixamo-user-clips.licence: Adobe General Terms + Mixamo FAQ: royalty-free use in personal, commercial and non-profit projects including games; raw character/animation files may not be redistributed as standalone files; no credit required; not for AI/ML training
mixamo-user-clips.redistribution: Only embedded in the game. Raw FBX files are kept out of the repository (.gitignore *.fbx, raw-sources/).
mixamo-user-clips.note: The official Mixamo FAQ page returned HTTP 403 to this environment; the terms were confirmed from Adobe community answers quoting the FAQ. Re-check https://helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html before release.
